summary: ngircd is a portable and lightweight Internet Relay Chat server designed specifically for small or private networks. It provides a straightforward text-based communication channel without the overhead of larger enterprise chat platforms. Written in C, it serves as a traditional IRC daemon to route messages between connected clients.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you want to set up a private chat server for a small group or a local network with minimal resource consumption.
watchOut: Development activity is currently slowing down, and it lacks the modern features and integrations found in newer team chat applications.
deployNotes: As a compiled C binary packaged as a deb, it typically runs as a standalone system service and usually handles TLS either natively or via a separate reverse proxy.
